text:
```yaml
name: Devin on Label

on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  create-devin-session:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event.label.name == 'devin'
    steps:
      - name: Extract issue data
        id: extract
        run: |
          ISSUE_TITLE=$(jq -r '.issue.title' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          ISSUE_URL=$(jq -r '.issue.html_url' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          ISSUE_BODY=$(jq -r '.issue.body' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")
          echo "ISSUE_TITLE=$ISSUE_TITLE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "ISSUE_URL=$ISSUE_URL" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "ISSUE_BODY=$ISSUE_BODY" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create Devin session
        id: create_session
        env:
          DEVIN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -X POST https://api.devin.ai/v1/sessions \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEVIN_API_KEY" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"prompt\": \"Issue: $ISSUE_TITLE\\nURL: $ISSUE_URL\\nBody: $ISSUE_BODY\"}")
          SESSION_URL=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -r '.session_url')
          echo "session_url=$SESSION_URL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "SESSION_URL=$SESSION_URL" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Comment on issue
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        env:
          SESSION_URL: ${{ steps.create_session.outputs.session_url }}
        with:
          script: |
            const issueNumber = context.issue.number;
            const sessionUrl = process.env.SESSION_URL;
            await github.issues.createComment({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: issueNumber,
              body: `Devin session created: ${sessionUrl}`
            });
```
